facts.fact_text: In 2003 a presidential election was held in Armenia.
The first round of the 2003 Armenian presidential election took place on 19 February 2003.
The second round of the 2003 Armenian presidential election took place on 5 March 2003.
The applicant acted as an authorised election assistant (վստահված անձ) for the main opposition candidate in the 2003 Armenian presidential election.
Following the first and second rounds of the 2003 Armenian presidential election, a series of protest rallies were organised in Yerevan by the opposition parties.
On 21 February 2003 the applicant participated in a demonstration held in Yerevan.
On 22 February 2003 two police officers went to the applicant's flat.
On 22 February 2003 two police officers took the applicant to the Central District Police Department of Yerevan.
At the Central District Police Department of Yerevan, an administrative case was initiated against the applicant on account of his participation in the demonstration of 21 February 2003.

On 22 February 2003, several hours after being taken to the Central District Police Department of Yerevan, the applicant was taken to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan (Երևան քաղաքի Կենտրոն և Նորք-Մարաշ համայնքների առաջին ատյանի դատարան).
At the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, the applicant was brought before Judge H.
Judge H. conducted a brief hearing in the applicant's case.
Judge H. sentenced the applicant under Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – "the CAO") to 15 days of administrative detention.
Judge H. found that on 21 February 2003 the applicant participated together with a group of people in an unauthorised demonstration in Yerevan.
The applicant was taken to a detention facility following his sentencing.
On 1 March 2003 the President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal (ՀՀ քրեական և զինվորական գործերով վերաքննիչ դատարանի նախագահ) reviewed the applicant's conviction.

The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found that the applicant, according to the decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, was subjected to administrative detention for the violation of the prescribed rules for organising and holding assemblies, demonstrations, street marches and rallies.

The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found that on 21 February 2003 the applicant participated in an unauthorised demonstration and street march, during which he violated public order.

The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found, having reviewed the applicant's appeal and the materials concerning the administrative offence, that the penalty imposed on the applicant must be changed.

The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal changed the applicant's penalty to an administrative fine of 1,000 Armenian drams (AMD), which was approximately 1.5 euros (EUR) at the material time.
The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal ordered the applicant's release from detention.
On 1 March 2003 the applicant was released from detention after having served approximately seven days of his 15-day sentence.
